rule: A1: a nissan window-regulator number's class is read from every catalog part name the raw prints for it (list rows on every page with site:lists:L<line>, product records with site:records:L<line>): 'Motor Assy-...' -> motor ('window motor only'), 'Regulator Assy-...' -> regulator (no packaging words: the name does not say whether the motor comes with it). A2/A3: names that mix motor and regulator, name a component (glass, cover, lens, bezel, knob, cap, garnish, holder, bulb, socket, finisher, housing, base, bracket, switch, cable, harness, motor outside wiper-motor) or are missing from the raw hold the group (held_part_name).
cause: positions.packaging() reads 'Motor Assy-Regulator, RH' as 'reg?' (the head holds 'Regulator'), and PACK_TEXT has no words for 'reg?', so no nissan note said 'window motor only'. positions.py is a policy input (policy_sha256), so the fix reads the names in curate.py for nissan only (_name_class / _note_pack); c.packaging is unchanged.

gauge-cluster.note: no gauge-cluster group is left in the round-9 candidate (the three of 1119i are held by B1, B4: 24820-89Y00, 24820-8B703, 24820-3ZD1C)
